## What changes?

Describe the final behavior. Link the related issue if one exists.

## Why?

Explain the problem and any important trade-off.

## How was it checked?

List relevant commands and manual checks, including anything not tested.

- [ ] Changes follow the contributor guide; non-trivial designs were discussed first.
- [ ] Relevant tests, types and lint pass; skipped fixtures are not presented as acceptance.
- [ ] User/contributor documentation reflects the change.
- [ ] No credentials, private source, personal data or one-time links are included.

For UI changes, include a sanitized screenshot when helpful. For access, execution,
migration or deployment changes, explain how existing boundaries remain protected.
